hero.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance for a Secure Digital Future
hero.lead: Ablin Limited helps organisations navigate regulatory complexity, manage technology and information risk, strengthen compliance, protect data and adopt emerging technologies responsibly.

frameworks.title: Frameworks we advise on
frameworks.lead: The standards and regulations our advice is built around. We help you prepare for them, and we do not issue certificates.
frameworks.note: Advisory and readiness support only. Independent bodies carry out assessments and issue any certificate.

capabilities.title: Core capabilities
capabilities.lead: Three areas where organisations most often need clear, practical support.

items.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance
items.description: Governance structures, risk management and compliance programmes that show leadership what is required and how it is being met.

items.title: Cybersecurity & Technology Risk
items.description: Cybersecurity governance, vulnerability management and IT controls, set against the frameworks and regulations that apply to you.

items.title: Data Protection & AI Governance
items.description: Data protection and privacy obligations, and governance over how emerging technologies are adopted and used.

services.title: How we can help
services.lead: Eight areas of advisory work, each covering the obligations, risks and controls involved.

audiences.title: Organisations that need clear governance over risk
audiences.lead: Our work suits organisations that must show they manage risk well, whatever their size.

why.title: Why Ablin
why.lead: What you can expect when you work with us.

points.title: Governance first
points.description: We start from your obligations and risks, not from a product or a toolset.

points.title: Practical delivery
points.description: Controls and documents sized to your organisation, and usable by your team.

points.title: Technology-aware
points.description: We understand the systems behind the risks, including cloud, data and AI.

points.title: Advisory, not certification
points.description: We prepare you for assessments such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Independent bodies carry out the assessments and issue certificates.

insights.title: Guidance on the areas we advise on
insights.lead: Practical articles on these topics will be published in Insights.

cta.title: Discuss your governance, risk and compliance requirements
cta.body: Tell us what you are working towards and we will advise on where to start.

statement.text: Good governance is not paperwork. It is knowing what your organisation must do, who is responsible for it, and whether it is working.
